About

Instant and long-lasting hydration from within with 3x Effect: 1 Soothe. 2 Refresh. 3 Hydrate. A facial mist spray with Hyaluronic Acid and Gluco-Glycerol that supports instant and long-lasting hydration for smooth and radiant skin.
NART: 66857-09900-21

Instant, long-lasting hydration for face, neck, and décolleté

Skin needs water to work efficiently and effectively to ensure the skin is well hydrated, smooth, supple and radiant. When the skin’s natural protection barrier is compromised, it loses moisture and becomes dehydrated. Dehydrated skin looks dull, feels tight and is unable to keep external irritants at bay and so can become sensitive. Intense and long-lasting hydration is necessary to keep your skin looking and feeling its best.

Mist sprays that don’t contain hydrating ingredients are unable to bind moisture. Pure water evaporates fast, making skin even drier than before and making it become sensitive. The unique formula in Hyaluron Mist Spray enhances the skin’s own hydration system, distributing water evenly, locking in moisture, and making the skin smooth and radiant.

The combination of Hyaluronic Acid and nature-identical Gluco-Glycerol helps to activate the skin’s own moisture. Gluco-Glycerol activated moisture distribution channels, helps to transport water between the skin cells and support skin hydration and moisture balance from within.

Clinical Formula

Hyaluronic acid

Hyaluronic Acid is formed by skin cells and is part of the connective tissue of the skin. One of its key functions is to retain moisture, and it has the ability to bind in between 1,000 and 10,000 times its own weight in water (i.e. one gram binds between one and ten liters). As we age, the skin's natural ability to produce Hyaluronic Acid depletes and wrinkles start to form and deepen.

Learn More
Glyco-glycerol

Being a derivative of the skin’s own humectant glycerol, glyercyl glucosides facilitate epidermal moisturization. Dry, stressed skin shows significant reduced aquaporin channels. These channels control the transport of cellular water and other small solutes between and into cells. Thus, playing an important role in maintaining epidermal water balance. The most abundant aquaporin in the epidermis is aquaporin-3 (AQP3). Glucosylglycerol (Gluco-glycerol) stimulates the expression of AQP3 in epidermal skin cells and has been shown to stimulate the formation of aquaporin 3 (AQP3) in skin cells, thus increasing the number of aquaporins that control water transport in and out of cells.

FAQ

What is Hyaluronic Acid?

Hyaluronic Acid is a substance naturally produced by the skin that helps it to bind in moisture: it can hold thousands of times its own weight in water. It’s a component of the extra cellular matrix of the epidermis (the outermost layers of skin) and the dermis (the middle layers of skin) and plumps up skin volume from the inside.

Is the spray pH skin-neutral?

Yes. The pH value of the HYALURON SPRAY is matched to the natural pH value of the skin. This means the natural protective barrier will not become irritated, the moisture is better retained in the skin and the product is even suitable for sensitive skin.

Can the spray also be used on sensitive skin?

Yes, due to its pH-friendly value, the spray is also suitable for sensitive skin and has been tested accordingly.

Can the spray also be sprayed on the body?

Yes, the spray can also be used all over the body, e.g. to freshen up a previously used care product.

Is there a high spray loss when applying the spray?

No, due to the use of a special aluminum bottle and propellant gas, it is ensured that the spray is evenly distributed in a thin layer on the skin.
